info.title: Wufoo Universal API
info.description: Build forms, collect entries, accept payments, and review reports.

get.description: Retrieves the comment count for a Wufoo form.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The form hash or identifier whose comments to count.

schema.description: The form hash or identifier whose comments to count.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

count.description: The number of comments currently stored for the form.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
